headline: Barry Callebaut cocoa fermentation; pladis scouts cocoa tech; natural mould inhibitors
summary: Barry Callebaut's Flavourcode cocoa-fermentation platform dominated the week's coverage, a direct competitor move that Belcolade should benchmark and answer with its own fermentation-flavour offer.
pladis is publicly seeking food-tech partners for sugar reduction and cocoa supply, a clear opening to pitch Belcolade cocoa-saving and sugar-reduced chocolate solutions.
Roquette (Wellence GF 1229) and Palsgaard (powdered cake emulsifier) launched competing gluten-free and cake ingredients; benchmark them against Puratos gluten-free mixes and cake improvers.

Clean-label shelf life is rising on US bakers' agendas, with trade guidance on matching conventional preservatives using natural mould inhibitors, a direct fit for Puratos fermentation-based preservation.

US ultra-processed-food and synthetic-dye policy remains the key regulatory watch, with a federal UPF definition and dye bans pending while Sweden's food agency questions the NOVA approach; keep clean-label and natural-colour reformulations ready.
